an5.30:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
an5.30:1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgala vanasaṇḍe.
an5.30:1.5: “samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito icchānaṅgalaṃ anuppatto icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.-
an5.30:1.6: ”taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
an5.30:1.7: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
an5.30:1.8: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti”.-
an5.30:1.9: “so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ, brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an5.30:1.10: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī”ti.
an5.30:1.11: atha kho icchānaṅgalakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tassā rattiyā accayena pahūtaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya yena icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bahidvārakoṭṭhake aṭṭhaṃsu uccāsaddā mahāsaddā.
an5.30:2.1: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā nāgito bhagavato upaṭṭhāko hoti.
an5.30:2.2: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nāgitaṃ āmantesi:
an5.30:2.3: ke panete nāgita uccāsaddā mahāsaddā kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilopeti?
an5.30:2.4: “ete bhante icchānaṅgalikā brāhmaṇagahapatikā pahutaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ ādāya bahidvārakoṭṭhake ṭhitā bhagavantaṃ yeva uddissa bhikkhusaṅghañcā”ti.
an5.30:2.5: māhaṃ nāgita yasena samāgamo, mā ca mayā yaso.
an5.30:2.6: yo kho nāgita nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.30:2.7: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyyāti.
an5.30:3.3: yena yeneva’dāni bhante bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇa gahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca.
an5.30:3.4: seyyathāpi bhante thullaphusitake deve vassante yathāninnaṃ udakāni pavattanti,
an5.30:3.5: evameva kho bhante yena yeneva’dāni bhagavā gamissati, tanninnāva bhavissanti brāhmaṇagahapatikā negamā ceva jānapadā ca
an5.30:4.1: māhaṃ nāgita yasena samāgamo, mā ca mayā yaso.
an5.30:4.2: yo kho nāgita nayimassa nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī assa akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, yassāhaṃ nekkhammasukhassa pavivekasukhassa upasamasukhassa sambodhasukhassa nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.30:4.3: so taṃ mīḷhasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ lābhasakkārasilokasukhaṃ sādiyeyya.
an5.30:4.6: piyānaṃ kho nāgita vipariṇāmaññathābhāvā uppajjanti sokaparideva dukkhadomanassupāyāsā.
an5.30:4.8: asubhanimittānuyogaṃ anuyuttassa kho nāgita subhanimitte pāṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti.
an5.30:4.10: chassu kho nāgitaḷu phassāyatanesu aniccānupassino viharato phasse pāṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti.
an5.30:4.12: pañcasu kho nāgita upādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato upādāne pāṭikkūlyatā saṇṭhāti.
